chats.answer:
If you want to use one monitor, keyboard, and mouse with both a laptop and a desktop PC, a 2-computer KVM switch is what you need.

For a laptop + desktop setup, I recommend looking at a USB-C KVM switch with HDMI or DisplayPort. This is especially convenient if your laptop supports video output over USB-C.

How the setup works
Press a button or use a hotkey to switch your monitor and peripherals between the two computers.

The main thing to check is whether you want a KVM that also charges your laptop through USB-C. Not all models support that.
